name: Grandma Trading & Agencies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Grandma Trading and Agencies Ltd trades in shares and commodities and deals in real estate.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GTAL was engaged in the business of trading
 in shares and commodities. Currently, the company is exploring new business opportunities in real estate redevelopment projects in and around the suburbs of the
Mumbai Metropolitan Region, but it is facing difficulties in raising funds due to its poor 
financial position.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -13.4% over last 3 years.
